notes.title: BIG NEWS!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, everyone! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911410/016c8ef569b3935b718f8148c9d83aed10e14490.png[/img]

🎮 To keep this short — yes, I’ve been brainstorming lots of ideas for future projects. Over the past month, I even created three logos for potential titles! But I must confess, the temptation to work on a second installment of "What Have You Done, Father?" is too much to resist!

This time, I plan to scale things up. Not necessarily by adding complex mechanics that might overwhelm me, but by focusing on quality. Many of you are familiar with my previous games, and while you’ve told me they look good, I know the characters are where they fall short — especially in terms of animation.

I want to fix this and take my games to the next level. While I can create beautiful character designs, I also want to breathe life into them with high-quality animations. This would allow me to create cooler cinematics and more dynamic character interactions — like picking up objects, seeing your hands in motion, and much more immersive moments.

To make this a reality, I need your help!

💡 [b]The Plan[/b]
I’ve found an incredible motion capture solution—the Smartsuit Pro from Rokoko—that’s perfect for indie developers like me. With this tool, I can finally add realistic, lifelike animations to my characters and make my games more immersive than ever before.

✨ [b]How You Can Support[/b]
I’ve set up a Ko-Fi page to fund this motion capture gear. Any donation, big or small, will go directly toward making this dream come true and bringing my characters—and stories—to life!

🖤 [b]Thank You[/b]
Your support means the world to me. Together, we can make this happen and create something truly special.

👉 [h2]Support me here:[/h2]
[h2][url=https://ko-fi.com/darkaniaworks]My crowdfunding campaign! [/url][/h2]

notes.title: Launch Broadcast
notes.content:
The wait is over! 

[b]"The Unluckiest Man"[/b] launches today and I'm more than happy to share with you my work.
Enjoy this short narrative experience I made specially for this Halloween and help Dragomir bury his beloved Catrina!

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42911410/a530c3f57a71843140881466da3cb3ba63afe1e1.png[/img]


You've heard it. The wait is over!
I am super excited to anounce that [b]The Unluckiest Man [/b] launches on October 27!
I have been working on this for almost 4 months, and I cannot wait to share with you the final result! 
Help poor Dragomir bury his beloved wife while exploring a small, decadent fishing town.
